title: AWS Backup Vault Lock
note: Lesson 2.2 fix (AWS-L22-003, S05): fetched from docs.aws.amazon.com and confirmed a governance-mode vault lock is removable by users with sufficient IAM permissions, while a compliance-mode vault lock becomes immutable (unchangeable and undeletable by any user, including the root user) once its mandatory cooling-off (grace) period, at least 3 days (72 hours), expires.
